definitions.gloss: test kit; testing kit (for medical, laboratory, or diagnostic tests)
definitions.explanation: A self-contained kit with the reagents, swabs, strips, and instructions needed to carry out a specific test — most often a diagnostic test for infection, pregnancy, drug use, water quality, or the like. Became a very familiar word in Japan during the COVID-19 pandemic, when home PCR and antigen test kits were widely sold.

examples.japanese: {薬局|やっきょく}で{検査|けんさ}キットを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a test kit at the pharmacy.

examples.japanese: {家|いえ}で{検査|けんさ}キットを{使|つか}って{結果|けっか}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I used a test kit at home and checked the result.

examples.japanese: {市販|しはん}の{検査|けんさ}キットで{陽性|ようせい}が{出|で}た{場合|ばあい}は、{医療機関|いりょうきかん}に{連絡|れんらく}してください。
examples.english: If an over-the-counter test kit shows a positive result, please contact a medical facility.

examples.japanese: パンデミックの{影響|えいきょう}で、{各家庭|かくかてい}に{検査|けんさ}キットを{備|そな}えておくという{習慣|しゅうかん}が{広|ひろ}まった。
examples.english: Due to the pandemic, the practice of keeping test kits on hand in each household became widespread.

notes:
Composed of {検査|けんさ} (inspection, test, examination) and キット (kit — loanword from English). A compound that became familiar to nearly all Japanese speakers during the COVID-19 pandemic.

USAGE:
The word is generic: the type of test is usually specified by another word placed before it, such as:
- {抗原|こうげん}{検査|けんさ}キット: antigen test kit
- PCR{検査|けんさ}キット: PCR test kit
- {妊娠|にんしん}{検査|けんさ}{薬|やく} — note: for pregnancy tests, {検査薬|けんさやく} (test drug/reagent) is more common than {検査|けんさ}キット
- {水質|すいしつ}{検査|けんさ}キット: water-quality test kit

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {検査|けんさ}キットを{使|つか}う: to use a test kit
- {検査|けんさ}キットで{調|しら}べる: to check using a test kit
- {市販|しはん}の{検査|けんさ}キット: an over-the-counter / commercially available test kit
- {検査|けんさ}キットが{陽性|ようせい} / {陰性|いんせい}: the test kit is positive / negative

RELATED TERMS:
- {検査|けんさ}: test, inspection, examination — the base word
- {検査薬|けんさやく}: testing reagent, test drug (often for pregnancy tests)
- {抗原|こうげん}{検査|けんさ}: antigen test
- PCR {検査|けんさ}: PCR test
- {自己|じこ}{検査|けんさ}: self-testing
- セルフチェック: self-check (a loanword with similar meaning)
